name: Furnace of the First Breach
prompt: Generate one finished individual monumental dungeon environment cinematic for Arcanea: The Sovereign Depths. Landscape 16:9. Place: Furnace of the First Breach, Volcanic underworks. ARCHITECTURE AND LIGHT: Circular basalt excavation, dry upper ore galleries, flooded cooling trenches below, broken hanging elevator and one furnace still burning behind a sealed wheel; ash-blue light through roof fracture and restrained ember light below. Design a physically coherent traversable place: foreground entry with two tiny ADULT expedition figures and readable equipment, middle-distance route with one meaningful interruption or tactical junction, and a distant iconic landmark. The camera stands at a plausible arrival viewpoint that reveals exploration choices. Add evidence of the place's original work, later abandonment or occupation, and current ecological/weather process through a few precise details. Keep one dominant spatial silhouette, three clear depth planes and generous areas of visual rest. Physical craft is visible in stone joints, structural supports, water levels and paths. No boss in this environment plate: the inhabitants are implied through tracks, damage, tools or closed thresholds. Keep specific regional palette and material identity rather than defaulting everything to blue/gold. Architectural scale should be overwhelming yet intelligible. Original adult high-fantasy cinematic physical realism, exceptional feature-film VFX craftsmanship and authored key-art composition. Natural adult anatomy, credible structural load and contact, distinct material light response, one motivated light hierarchy, atmospheric depth, finely resolved foreground and controlled distant detail. No anime, cartoon, cute eyes, mascot proportions, toy plastic, decorative armour filigree, generic giant crown, arbitrary extra limbs, floating text, UI, signature or watermark. Supernatural effects serve a readable action, never cover the subject. Do not reproduce recognizable existing franchise characters, symbols or silhouettes.
